title: fix(app-shell): a record page that places no component explains itself, and Studio seeds an uncopyable full record page slotted
body:
Fixes #32478
Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — widening: the two empty.recordPagePlacesNoComponent* keys; narrowing: the PageKindNodeSchema attach
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — the spec already refuses this shape at every door (checkPageRecordPlacesComponent); no author-facing teaching changes

**A `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review is owed before the queue**: the `(narrowing)` arm narrows what `@object-ui/types` accepts (`PageKindNodeSchema`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台打开某对象的记录时，若它的 `full` 记录页一个组件都没放，就在页面主体位置显示一块说明（点名该页面，并说明在 Studio 里怎么修），不再是空白；Studio「新建页面」里四条无法复制默认布局的 `full` 记录页路径改为以 `slotted` 创建，第一次保存就能成功；objectui 的页面类型节点（`PageKindNodeSchema`）也开始用 spec 同一条规则拒收这种空记录页。
- 为什么改：#32434 起，spec 在保存时拒收这种空记录页。但此前已存的行、以及包里平铺注册的页面，仍会让该对象的每条记录打开都是空白；Studio 的这四条创建路径则直接收到 422。
- 风险与回滚：只影响「`full` 记录页，且 regions 里没放任何组件」这一种页面，它们本来就是空白的；三处判断都直接调用 spec 的 `checkPageRecordPlacesComponent`，不另写规则。`@object-ui/types` 的接受集收窄（BREAKING，`minor`），合并前需一次 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 复核。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `RecordDetailView.tsx` 里新增的提前返回（`recordPagePlacesNoComponent`）；② `layout.zod.ts` 里 `PageKindNodeSchema` 末尾新挂的 `.superRefine(checkPageRecordPlacesComponent)`；③ `anchors.ts` 里 `createSeed` 的 `slotted` 回退。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.page-seed.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts -t 32478`，预期三个文件里带 32478 的用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无。本席已收班，未复核;下一任 `domain:ui` 席位做 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 复核与席位复核后落地。

## What changes

Card #32478 lists three console follow-ups to the spec refusal `checkPageRecordPlacesComponent` (`@objectstack/spec/ui`, landed by #32434). This PR delivers all three. Item 2 landed in patch round 1, once the claim's file surface was widened (amendment 6821076002).

**Item 1: the record view explains a record page that places no component** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`)

- `usePageAssignment` splits on `kind` only, and `effectivePage = assignedPage || synthesizedPage`. An assigned `kind: 'full'` record page whose `regions` place nothing is truthy, so it won and drew as authored: the breadcrumb and an empty panel, for every record of its object.
- The view now asks the spec's own check. `recordPagePlacesNoComponent` calls `checkPageRecordPlacesComponent` with a collecting refinement context, so the console's judgment is the spec's and no copy of the rule exists here. Where the check refuses the authored page, the view draws an `Empty` panel in place of the page body (`data-testid="record-page-places-no-component"`). The panel names the page and gives the spec's three fixes, worded for Studio: add components to a region, make the page `slotted`, or delete the page.
- It does not swap in the default record page. A page shows what its author composed, per the ruling already quoted in this file beside `stripDiscussionNodes`. A silent swap would also be the consumer-side tolerance of off-spec metadata that AGENTS.md Prime Directive 12 and `ui/AGENTS.md` commandment 0.1 rule out. The refused named page route in the same file sets the precedent: it draws no fallback.
- Placement: after the record-status guards. A missing record, a forbidden read or a failed read still shows its own state first. Like the refused named page, the panel stamps no print root. The page is judged as authored (`resolvedPage`), before `pruneUnregisteredRecordPageObjects`. The record drawer shows the same panel.
- Unchanged: pages that place a component, `slotted` pages, `html` and `react` pages (the check skips both kinds), and objects with no assigned page.
- New keys in all eleven packs: `empty.recordPagePlacesNoComponent` and `empty.recordPagePlacesNoComponentDescription`. zh-Hant is regenerated with `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant` (two lines).

**Item 2: `PageKindNodeSchema` runs the spec's check** (`ui/packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`)

- The kind node, a stored spec page whose `type` is its page kind, now chains `.superRefine(checkPageRecordPlacesComponent)` beside its two siblings, `checkPageDefaultPlacement` and `checkPageRecordBindingPlacement`. All three read the page kind from `type`, which this node carries. On the `page` node `type` is the component discriminator `'page'`, so there the check would never fire, and it is not attached.
- So `safeValidateSchema`, and `objectui validate` with it, refuses a `full` `record` kind node that places no component, at `regions` and with the spec's own sentence, where it used to accept it. This is the narrowing: BREAKING, `@object-ui/types` `minor`, ADR-0087 `not-required (already-registered page-record-no-component-refused)`.
- Attached as-is, the seat's ruling (option A, amendment 6821076002): `children` is not read. A `{ type: 'record', children: […] }` kind node with no placed region is refused too. The spec refuses that document anyway, because its page declares no `children`, and the record view judges a record page by the same check. Judging only a kind node with no `children` was not chosen: it would be a second reading of a rule the spec owns.
- Census: the name stays in the `PageNodeSchema` row's `notAttachable` list, where its two siblings are, with the comment now saying the kind node attaches it. `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts` lists the binding in `REFINEMENT_EXCEPTIONS`.

**Item 3: Studio's create seed for an explicit `full` record page** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.ts`)

- Four paths of `createSeed` returned `{}`: no object chosen, a falsy object definition, a synthesized page with no regions, and a failed fetch. The draft's `kind: 'full'` then saved with the create defaults' `regions: []`, which the spec refuses at `regions`, so the save answered 422.
- Each of the four now returns `{ kind: 'slotted' }`. A `slotted` record page with no slots is the object's default record page on the day it is created, and it keeps following the object. The designer's "Convert to full page" still makes it `full` once the object is readable. Whether the synthesized regions place a component is judged by the same spec check, so a synthesis whose regions are present but empty also falls back.
- Measured on the spec built from this branch: `{ type: 'record', kind: 'slotted', regions: [] }` is accepted bound and unbound, while the same body with `kind: 'full'` is refused `custom` at `regions`.
- Unchanged: the success path (synthesized regions placing components are copied under `full`) and the non-`full` path (`{ kind: 'slotted' }`, as before).

## Tests

- `RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx` gains the top-level block `RecordDetailView.recordPagePlacesNoComponent-32478`, opened with `restoreAfterBlock()` as the harness asks:
  - the premise, re-read live: the spec refuses both fixtures at `regions` and accepts the one that places a component;
  - a `full` page whose region places nothing, and a `full` page with no `regions`, draw the panel naming the page and no `[data-page-type]` root;
  - the record drawer does the same;
  - CONTROLS: the same page placing a component draws that page; a `slotted` page with no slots, and no assigned page, draw the default record page with no panel.
- Fixture triage in the same harness: the `appScopedPage-29592` block's `userPage` placed `components: []`, which the spec now refuses. It now places a `text` component in the spec's `properties` bag ("add the declaration"); every assertion of that block is unchanged.
- `anchors.page-seed.test.ts`: the two pins that asserted `{}` (no object chosen; a swallowed failure) are flipped, not deleted. They are now rows of `page createSeed — a full record page with nothing to copy starts slotted (objectstack#32478)`, beside the two other paths. Each row asserts:
  - the seed is `{ kind: 'slotted' }`;
  - the create-mode body passes the spec's `PageSchema`;
  - the body the path saved before is refused `custom` at `regions`.

  A CONTROL keeps the copied-regions path under `full`.
- `spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts` gains `objectstack#32478 — the Page record-places-component refusal reaches the page-kind node, and only there`:
  - three kind nodes the spec refuses at `regions` (bound with no `regions`, bound with an empty region, unbound), each refused by the kind node with the spec's own issue;
  - the as-is boundary: a bound kind node carrying only `children` is refused at `regions` too, and the spec refuses that document;
  - CONTROLS: a `record` kind node that places a component, a `slotted` one and a `home` one pass the spec and the kind node, and the `page` node does not judge it.
- `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts` lists the binding in `REFINEMENT_EXCEPTIONS`; `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`'s two count pins go 116 → 117 for the one paired span the German string adds.

- `3ab5e923c`, every `RecordDetailView*.test.tsx` and `metadata-admin/anchors*.test.ts` (96 files): `Test Files 96 passed (96) · Tests 705 passed (705)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

  - expected direction, observed: `Tests 4 failed | 42 passed (46)`, the 4 kind-node refusal pins red; the control, the census and every other block green;
  - restored: blob equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, tree clean.
- `4cc69448b`, the final head, after merging `origin/main` `9cd5fc161` once (lockfile unchanged; zh-Hant `gen:zh-hant` reads current):

  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/i18n/ scripts/ packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.page-seed.test.ts`: `Test Files 664 passed | 2 skipped (666) · Tests 17518 passed | 15 skipped (17533)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`;

## Acceptance notes

- Item 2 follows the seat's ruling (option A, amendment 6821076002): attached as-is, for parity with the spec. A `{ type: 'record', children: […] }` kind node with no placed region is now refused. `content/docs/frontend/layout.mdx` ("Detail Page with Actions") teaches the `page`-node spelling of that shape, `{ type: 'page', pageType: 'record', children: […] }`, and the `page` node keeps accepting it.
- `Clause-②` spelling: the line the seat proposed, `yes (widening: …; the PageKindNodeSchema attach narrows)`, makes Check Changeset's level axis refuse the PR, measured offline with `--event`: "metadata-protocol `narrowed` contradicts clause-② `yes (widening)`". The line above, `yes (narrowing) — widening: …; narrowing: …`, reads as value `yes`, arm `narrowing` through `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`. That is the reader's spelling for a diff that widens and narrows. Both changeset gates pass with it (`--event` exit 0; ADR-0087 "1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition").
- Judged before pruning: an authored page whose every component names an object this install does not hold is pruned empty and still draws blank. Not this check's population; not measured here.
- `ui/AGENTS.md` commandment 2 (docs-driven): a grep of `content/docs/frontend/**` finds no passage about an assigned record page that places nothing, so no docs page is changed.
